items.label: Small Side Table
items.value: The side table features a walnut-grain pattern and a distinctive color, which creates a stylish appearance. The rounded tabletop makes it safer, and one of its legs utilizes wooden balls as connectors, adding an elegant touch. It is the ideal choice for minimalist furniture, enhancing the ambiance of your room

items.label: Sturdy Structure
items.value: This drink table is crafted from high-density MDF and finished with a water-resistant coating. The base of this small drink table has a relatively large area and a thickened double-layer design, which ensures the stability of this side table and prevents it from sliding or tilting

items.label: Multiple Functions
items.value: Ideal as a small side table next to the sofa, a couch end table, a nightstand beside the bed, a small drink table outdoors, or even a plant stand, this versatile side table serves multiple purposes and meets various needs in your home

items.label: Compact Size
items.value: The overall dimensions of this round side table are 11.8''Dia. x 21.6''high. Featuring a compact and lightweight design, the round side table saves space and allows for effortless placement anywhere

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: This small table is easy to assemble without any tools, following the user-friendly instuction you can finish it in 5 minutes. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us – we're here to assist you every step of the way
